name: Living Cryostasis Convergence · Water
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.65-block radius for 19.5 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2.25 ❤ arcane
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 6 s
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 5.65 blocks with 39% health
• Puts out fire
• Soaked for 12 s
• Knockback
